regime_context: The TSX thematic landscape shows broad rotation with Base Metals & Copper firmly in the lead, followed by Gold Miners and Big Banks. All three exhibit full breadth, no crowding, and pass the absolute-trend gate, indicating structurally lower drawdown risk. Past direction calls on this desk have been coin-flip accurate (dir_accuracy 0.5), so any leans are low-confidence, trend-following conditionals, not return forecasts.
emerging_watch: Base Metals & Copper: watch for breadth dropping below 0.8 and the momentum score falling below 1.0 — that would signal waning leadership and potentially retiring the overweight thesis.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Current leader with strong momentum score, broad participation, and trend-gate eligibility. Durability suggests the trend is persistent, and no crowding reduces reflexivity risk. Overweight as long as the trend structure remains intact.
theses.dissent: Base metals are highly sensitive to global demand and commodity prices; a reversal in copper or a risk-off shift could send the theme sharply lower even if trends currently look durable.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO lags the S&P/TSX Composite by more than 3% and closes below its 50-day moving average before the 20-day horizon.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners display a trend-tagged uptrend, high durability, and full breadth. In an environment where macro headlines include geopolitics, the theme may serve as a risk hedge. The absolute-trend gate signals lower relative drawdown risk.
theses.dissent: A stronger Canadian dollar, rising real rates, or a shift in market focus away from geopolitical risks could undermine gold miners, and momentum could mean-revert abruptly.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO underperforms the S&P/TSX Composite by more than 4% before the 20-day horizon.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks combine a top-3 momentum score, full breadth, and no crowding. As a core equity-income component, the trend-gate eligibility supports a lower drawdown profile compared to themes without it.
theses.dissent: Banks face latent risks from a slowing housing market, credit cycle deterioration, or regulatory headwinds that could erode earnings and trigger a rotation out of financials.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO underperforms the S&P/TSX Composite by more than 2% and closes below its 50-day moving average before the 20-day horizon.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
